title: AI Engineer
description: The WowWe’re looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to build best in class applications and solutions at Betsson Group. You’ll develop AI solutions and applications, context systems and AI Agents, maintain and enhance multiple AI system and products, research frontier models and collaborate with product and architecture teams to deliver high-performing services used by millions of players. This is an opportunity to work with bleeding edge technology, build world-class products.A taster of what you will be involved with As an engineer, your focus will be on developing and maintain, modular and reusable systems, explore new technologies and find solutions to enhance our products.You’ll participate on design discussions, troubleshoot complex problems, and contribute directly to our codebase.
